description: This file contains action creators for handling WebSocket events related to burn-on-read posts in Mattermost, including post revealed and all revealed events, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: handleBurnOnReadPostRevealed
methods.description: Handles the WebSocket event for a post being revealed in burn-on-read posts, updating recipients or revealed content based on user role.

methods.name: handleBurnOnReadAllRevealed
methods.description: Handles the WebSocket event indicating all recipients have revealed the post, updating the post with the sender's expiration time.
